questions.question: Which sentence correctly uses inversion to express emphasis in a hypothetical scenario?
options: Only if you had studied hard would you have passed the exam.
Had you studied hard, you would have passed the exam.
You would pass the exam if you studied hard.
If you studied hard, you would have passed the exam.
questions.answer: Had you studied hard, you would have passed the exam.

questions.question: Which sentence employs a cleft construction to highlight the subject of the main clause?
options: It was important that the project was completed on time.
The fact that the project was completed on time was crucial.
The project’s completion on time was what mattered most.
To complete the project on time was essential.
questions.answer: The fact that the project was completed on time was crucial.

questions.question: Which sentence correctly uses a third conditional with the subjunctive mood to express regret over past actions?
options: If I had known about the meeting, I would have attended.
If I knew about the meeting, I would have attended.
If I know about the meeting, I would attend.
If I know about the meeting now, I would have attended.
questions.answer: If I had known about the meeting, I would have attended.

questions.question: Which sentence demonstrates the use of ellipsis in a complex sentence to maintain coherence?
options: She left the room, and the silence that followed was deafening.
She left the room, the silence was deafening.
After she left, the silence was deafening.
The silence was deafening when she left the room.
questions.answer: She left the room, and the silence that followed was deafening.

questions.question: Which sentence uses formal register and a passive construction to convey indirect criticism?
options: The report was poorly written and lacked clarity.
It was noted that the report’s presentation could be improved.
The report was a mess; it needed to be redone.
Many found the report confusing and difficult to follow.
questions.answer: It was noted that the report’s presentation could be improved.
